title: Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development
description_html:
Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development

Affiliate Marketing / MarTech — Acceleration Partners

LOCATION

This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Applicants can be based in the US, UK, or Germany.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hunter to drive new client acquisition for our Affiliate Marketing & Influencer Services. This is a new business development role built for someone who thrives on opening doors: sourcing opportunities, building relationships with enterprise decision-makers, and running a deal from first contact through close. Our marketing team generates inbound leads and our sales support team provides collateral and financial modeling, but the right candidate won't wait for leads to come to them.

This role is built around a team-based selling model. You bring the opportunity in the door, qualify it, and manage the relationship and the process; our strategy and account management teams build the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and lead the pitch delivery. You're the connective tissue between the prospect and our experts, and the role suits driven, relationship-first sellers who want to sell alongside a strong internal team rather than carry the full strategic load alone.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. New Business Development: Proactively source and build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and strategic networking, in addition to working inbound leads. You are a hunter first, and pipeline generation is the core measure of this role.
  2. Deal Management & Sales Process Ownership: Own large, complex deals ($500K+ annual contract value) from first contact through close, managing the timeline and multiple decision-makers across marketing, ecommerce, finance, and executive leadership.
  3. Discovery & Qualification: Ask the right questions to understand each prospect's business, priorities, and buying process well enough to qualify the opportunity and brief our strategy team.
  4. Orchestrating the Pitch: Bring in our strategy and account management teams at the right points in the sales cycle to build and deliver the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and the RFP response. Your job is to set the stage, make introductions, prep the room, and coordinate the team so the pitch lands.
  5. Pipeline Discipline & Market Awareness: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting, and stay current on the Affiliate & Influencer Marketing space well enough to prospect credibly and know when to loop in strategy.

WHAT YOU BRING

Enterprise Sales Experience

  • Demonstrated track record of closing large enterprise deals, $500K+ in annual contract value
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across marketing, ecommerce, and executive functions, without needing to own the strategic pitch personally
  • Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at large enterprise companies; experience selling into large retailers is a strong plus

Hunter Mentality

  • Proven ability to source your own opportunities through outbound prospecting: cold outreach, industry events, LinkedIn, and relationship-based selling
  • Self-starter who doesn't rely solely on inbound leads, and is resilient and persistent about opening new doors

Digital Marketing Working Knowledge

  • General familiarity with the digital marketing space, enough to prospect credibly and hold an intelligent first conversation; deep strategic expertise isn't required, since that lives with our strategy and account management teams
  • Affiliate / Influencer marketing knowledge is a plus, not a requirement

Technical & Tools Proficiency

  • Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage
  • AI fluency, including using AI tools to work smarter in prospecting, research, and pipeline management
  • Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

Collaborative, Team-Based Selling

  • Genuine comfort handing off the strategic narrative to internal experts, and strong ability to coordinate across strategy, account management, and delivery teams in a fully remote environment
  • Skilled at reading a room well enough to know when to bring in an expert, and disciplined enough to prep that expert properly beforehand

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience
  • Demonstrated experience closing enterprise deals of $500K+ ACV
  • Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at large enterprise or retail brands
  • Proven track record of outbound pipeline generation
  • Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage
  • A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work
  • Must be based in the US, UK, Germany.
  • Ability to travel when and where required

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process, and on how the handoff to strategy and account management works. You've built an active outbound pipeline, are engaging multiple enterprise prospects, and know when and how to bring in the strategy team.

By 1 Year… You've closed multiple enterprise deals. Prospects consistently move smoothly from your first conversation into a strong strategy pitch, and the strategy and account management teams see you as a reliable partner who sets them up to win.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership and Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing. Serving over 200 brands with household names like Amazon, Target, Google, Warby Parker, Crocs, Reebok (to name a few) their diversified staff is creating what’s next in the industry by building balanced portfolios of high-performing partnerships. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, Acceleration Partners prides themselves on being on the cutting edge of new industry developments, and leveraging their proven expertise to bring unique solutions to the most complex challenges for brands who aim for growth

AP PERKS & BENEFITS — WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching / Pension contributions
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Target base salary is £55K–£60K GBP, with competitive, uncapped commission structure, based on location and experience

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Product Manager – Marketplace (100% Remote within Spain)
description_html:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

Job Description

At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.

Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.

As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further. You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.

This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes

    • Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.

    • Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.

    • Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.

    Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic

    • Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.

    • Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.

    • Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.

    Owning paid visibility and growth products

    • Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).

    • Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.

    Working data-first

    • Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.

    • Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.

    • Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.

    Operating as an AI-native Product Manager

    • Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and AI prototyping tools daily to accelerate discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.

    • Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.

    Collaborating across teams

    • Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.

    • Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.

    • Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.

What will set you up for success in this role?

  • Core Product Management experience

    • 5+ years of Product Management experience building digital consumer or marketplace products.

    • Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.

    • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Data teams.

    • Extreme ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping products in emerging spaces.

    Exceptionally data-driven

    • Fluent with SQL and comfortable querying large datasets to explore, size, and validate opportunities independently.

    • Proven ability to translate business logic into ranking, scoring, or matching logic – and to reason clearly about the trade-offs.

    • Strong analytical and experimentation skills; you make decisions from data and can defend them.

    Deep understanding of customer economics

    • Strong grasp of the metrics that drive a subscription marketplace: churn, retention, engagement, activation, ARPU, and lifetime value.

    • Experience owning or moving retention and engagement metrics for a customer base, not just shipping features.

    Marketplace and AI mindset

    • Understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics and the tension between supply-side outcomes and consumer experience.

    • Strong AI-native product mindset, with hands-on experience using AI tools in daily product workflows.

    • Ability to move quickly from research and discovery to execution and launch.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with search, ranking, relevance, recommendation, or matching systems.

  • Experience with pricing, monetisation, or visibility / ads products in a marketplace.

  • Experience owning customer success, retention, or supply-growth outcomes in partnership with commercial teams.

  • Background in healthcare, healthtech, wellness, or patient-engagement products.

  • Experience building AI products powered by LLMs or conversational interfaces, including chat evaluation and prompt optimisation.

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

  • Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).

  • Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).

  • 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.

  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).

  • Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

title: Platform Product Engineer
description_html:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Job:

Under the direction of the Director of Engineering, the Platform Product Engineer acts as a high-leverage technical leader bridging robust platform architecture and product-centric AI innovation. This role handles high-stakes ambiguity and complexity, balancing scalable infrastructure and platform foundation work with the direct delivery of user-facing AI product features. The Platform Product Engineer collaborates closely with Product, Architecture, and Platform leads to convert complex business requirements into high-integrity technical plans, advancing Zone’s product vision by engineering reliable AI features and agentic workflows embedded within a scalable, production-grade platform.

Essential Job Functions

  • Architect and deliver complex, high-value platform systems and customer-facing AI product features across the Zone platform, ensuring high performance, observability, and scalability.
  • Balance core platform engineering responsibilities with product engineering priorities, translating business and user needs into seamless technical execution.
  • Design and maintain foundational platform infrastructure to empower product teams to build, test, and ship AI-native capabilities rapidly and safely.
  • Drive the engineering of automated validation frameworks to verify AI-generated features and core business logic against strict financial standards.
  • Anticipate architectural pressure points and resolve bottlenecks before they impact roadmap delivery.
  • Champion the use of modern coding tools, agentic SDLC, and product-focused AI workflows to maximize engineering velocity and product quality.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and research, recommending innovative approaches
  • Manage time effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables
  • Exemplify Zone & Co’s culture, providing exceptional service and aligning with company values at all times

Responsibilities / Duties / Tasks

  • Architect, deploy, and support production-grade platform infrastructure and AI product features, including agentic workflows and interactive user experiences.
  • Decompose vague software requirements into staged execution plans that mitigate risk and enhance delivery predictability.
  • Establish and maintain robust automated validation and verification discipline for AI models and business logic.
  • Proactively refactor fragile path areas and maintain exemplary code quality in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and associated AI frameworks.
  • Translate technical debt and architectural tradeoffs into clear business consequences for engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Integrate AI/ML models with existing backend and frontend systems
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through rigorous design guidance, thorough code reviews, and the promotion of AI-native best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers
  • Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of new infrastructure or cloud services for AI workloads
  • Manage and optimize AWS services including ECS, Lambda, Postgres, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and Amplify for scalable AI and platform infrastructure
  • Communicate outcomes, technical details, and challenges to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Maintain a strong commitment to data quality, privacy, and ethical AI development
  • Engage in ongoing learning and professional development aligned with Zone & Co’s strategic objectives

Job Qualifications / Skill Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in the Fintech domain, with a strong focus on platform development, ERP integrations, or SaaS applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate development and design robust AI features.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript with proven experience handling complex backend architecture.
  • Strong database skills, both relational (i.e. SQL) and non-relational storage
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects from ambiguity to successful production delivery in an asynchronous, globally distributed environment.
  • Required hands-on expertise with AWS platform services (including ECS, Lambda, Postgres, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and Amplify), cloud infrastructure management, and deployment pipelines for scalable AI workloads.
  • Strong judgment in verification discipline and experience designing automated testing solutions for high-consequence business logic.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Passion for innovation and creating value through technology
  • Proficiency in AI-assisted coding, including building and maintaining custom skills and integrating with Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for tools like Jira.
  • Nice-to-have: Familiarity with data science principles and hands-on experience with model tuning.

What to Expect During Your Technical Interview
The technical interview focuses on high-level system design and real-world engineering challenges rather than traditional algorithm or syntax memorization exercises. Candidates will collaborate with interviewers on an interactive system design exercise, sketching out high-level architecture and discussing modern implementation approaches. Access to an AI coding assistant (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) during the interview is recommended, as we value leveraging AI tools to solve complex system problems effectively.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

United States

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

Non-US Jurisdictions

This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

Privacy Statement and Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Product Designer
description_html:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience our members rely on every day across iOS, Android and web.

You'll own the moments that matter: onboarding, listing homes, finding and applying for sits, matching with the right sitter or owner, preparing for a stay. This is a hands-on role as the primary designer in your squad. You'll have real strategic influence over your area's direction and drive measurable impact for both our members and the business.

What You'll Do

  • Design mobile-first experiences that work across iOS, Android and web, respecting platform conventions while staying consistent with our design system
  • Own discovery research and testing for your squad (interviews, usability testing, concept testing) and measure impact using product analytics and qualitative signals to guide iteration
  • Define problems and hypotheses with your squad, choose the right validation method to make sure we're building the right thing for our customers
  • Design AI-powered features for matching, personalisation and communication with trust and transparency built in, and use AI tools daily to speed up exploration, prototyping and synthesis
  • Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, user research, content, data and commercial teams, communicating design rationale clearly to stakeholders, facilitating workshops to create alignment and negotiating trade offs
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system, partnering with Design Systems to create robust, accessible, cross-platform patterns
  • Build solutions that scale. Map journeys and service relationships rather than solving problems in isolation, and champion craft and accessibility throughout

What you'll need

Strategy and systems thinking

Strong systems thinking with experience designing complex customer journeys end to end. Proven ability to set customer-centric vision and translate it into practical, phased delivery while balancing member needs with business goals and technical constraints.

Research and methodology

Hands-on user research skills, confident choosing methods and synthesising insight into clear design direction. Able to frame complex challenges into clear problem statements and testable hypotheses, with solid understanding of experimentation methods and when to use each.

Craft and execution

Exceptional interaction and visual design craft with meticulous attention to detail, including advanced prototyping and working within mature design systems. Deep knowledge of mobile interface guidelines and best practices, backed by a portfolio showing end-to-end, beautifully crafted, user-centred work with measurable impact on customer and business outcomes.

AI in design

Confident daily use of AI-assisted design and prototyping tools as part of your everyday workflow. You'll ideally be working in Cursor, Claude Code or similar for at least some of your workflow and you'll bring ideas of how AI tools can be used to drive efficiency and impact across the design process.

Collaboration and culture

Excellent communication and storytelling skills with comfort working in empowered, cross-functional squads. Experience in scale-ups with strong product and experimentation culture. You'll need to be confident in selling your ideas across the business, creating alignment and inspiring others.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI/ML-powered features such as recommendations engines and LLMs with good understanding of the UX challenges they create - trust, comprehension, feedback loops, agency etc.
  • Experience in two-sided marketplaces, subscription or membership businesses, or trust and safety-sensitive products.
  • Self-serve analytics experience (we use Amplitude, Mode) and familiarity with research depository tools such as Dovetail, Chattermill.

Our hiring process

  1. Intro call with hiring manager
  2. Technical portfolio review with PM, Design lead and Engineering partner
  3. Leadership and first 90 days presentation

What you'll bring

You'll own the product design process end-to-end.

At TrustedHousesitters we start with the customer. You'll need to be able to show us how you've used quantitative and qualitative user research to inform your approach to solving product design problems.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • Your design experience is web-only - you haven't shaped native iOS or Android app experiences.
  • Your background is mainly B2B, enterprise, or public sector - you're used to solving problems functionally, and this role needs you to think about design emotionally too.
  • You'd rather be handed a fully-scoped brief than help define the problem yourself - you'll be the primary designer in your squad, shaping direction, not just executing someone else's spec.
  • You're sceptical of AI having a genuine place in the design process, or you actively avoid using AI tools in your own workflow.
  • When you disagree with a decision, you tend to raise it and step back - we need people who'll stay in the room and help find the way through.

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

title: Enterprise Implementation Consultant - German Fluency

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara’s solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this. Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Own the project management including project plans, RAID logs and governance meetings
  • Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for each business process
  • Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior implementation consultant, project manager, or management consulting role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred
  • Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies
  • 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products
  • 2+ years running on-site workshops with over 10 stakeholders
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • German fluency
  • Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements.
  • Experience creating implementation methodologies and/or frameworks
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Product Manager – Marketplace (100% Remote within Poland)
description_html:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: ZnanyLekarz. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

Job Description

At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.

Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.

As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further. You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.

This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes

    • Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.

    • Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.

    • Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.

    Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic

    • Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.

    • Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.

    • Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.

    Owning paid visibility and growth products

    • Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).

    • Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.

    Working data-first

    • Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.

    • Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.

    • Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.

    Operating as an AI-native Product Manager

    • Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and AI prototyping tools daily to accelerate discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.

    • Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.

    Collaborating across teams

    • Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.

    • Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.

    • Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.

What will set you up for success in this role?

  • Core Product Management experience

    • 5+ years of Product Management experience building digital consumer or marketplace products.

    • Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.

    • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Data teams.

    • Extreme ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping products in emerging spaces.

    Exceptionally data-driven

    • Fluent with SQL and comfortable querying large datasets to explore, size, and validate opportunities independently.

    • Proven ability to translate business logic into ranking, scoring, or matching logic – and to reason clearly about the trade-offs.

    • Strong analytical and experimentation skills; you make decisions from data and can defend them.

    Deep understanding of customer economics

    • Strong grasp of the metrics that drive a subscription marketplace: churn, retention, engagement, activation, ARPU, and lifetime value.

    • Experience owning or moving retention and engagement metrics for a customer base, not just shipping features.

    Marketplace and AI mindset

    • Understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics and the tension between supply-side outcomes and consumer experience.

    • Strong AI-native product mindset, with hands-on experience using AI tools in daily product workflows.

    • Ability to move quickly from research and discovery to execution and launch.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with search, ranking, relevance, recommendation, or matching systems.

  • Experience with pricing, monetisation, or visibility / ads products in a marketplace.

  • Experience owning customer success, retention, or supply-growth outcomes in partnership with commercial teams.

  • Background in healthcare, healthtech, wellness, or patient-engagement products.

  • Experience building AI products powered by LLMs or conversational interfaces, including chat evaluation and prompt optimisation.

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

  • Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

  • Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Freelance - Spanish Data Annotation Specialist (100% Remote within Europe)
description_html:
How You'll Contribute

As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner, your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of our data for the Spanish market, and contributing directly to the quality and reliability of our AI-driven products in the medical domain.

This role is ideal for candidates with a strong linguistic background in Spanish who are passionate about working in the healthcare and technology space. The ideal candidate has experience in data annotation, transcription, and text analysis, combined with a basic understanding of medical terminology and concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and maintain medically oriented datasets for machine learning purposes, ensuring high-quality data annotation and consistency.

  • Follow and provide feedback on annotation and labeling conventions, as well as perform audio transcriptions in Spanish (aligning audio with text and correcting text based on audio).

  • Implement text patterns to detect and extract named entities in Spanish, such as names, addresses, organization names, ID numbers, and medical terms.

  • Contribute to dictionaries and taxonomies in Spanish for use in NLP systems.

  • Evaluate the correctness and accuracy of Spanish words, sentences, and text structures, ensuring linguistic quality and consistency.

  • Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines and communicate proactively about project progress and challenges.

What We're Looking For:

  • Languages: Native Spanish speaker and Full Professional Level of English

  • Linguistic Expertise: A degree or strong background in Italian linguistics, computational linguistics, or a related field.

  • Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with Spanish medical terminology or prior experience in the healthcare domain.

  • Data Annotation: Hands-on experience with data annotation, transcription, and labeling tools.

  • Text Analysis: Proficiency in working with text patterns and dictionaries for NLP purposes.

  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional ability to assess and improve data quality.

  • Self-Management: Strong ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines.

Which skills are 'bonus points'?

  • Previous experience in AI, machine learning, or data preparation projects.

  • Knowledge of multiple languages or dialects beyond Spanish and English.

  • Exposure to medical coding systems (e.g., ICD, CPT) or electronic health records (EHR).

  • Experience working as a freelancer on similar annotation or linguistic projects.

title: Backend Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at paddy
description_html:
Das ist kein gewöhnlicher Job. Wir arbeiten an dem, was unsere Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig macht: Bildung. Dafür bauen wir paddy, das Agentic Operating System für Teaching & Learning.

Unsere Mission ist es, Lehrkräfte zu entlasten, Lernergebnisse zu verbessern und die Unterrichtsqualität zu steigern.

Tausende Lehrkräfte und hunderttausende Lernende nutzen paddy bereits. Mit starken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell. Unsere Ambition ist es, den europäischen AI-Player für Bildung zu bauen.

Als Backend Engineer liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf Backend-Engineering und Architektur. Du konzipierst APIs, Datenmodelle und Services und verantwortest sie vom Verständnis des Nutzerproblems bis zum Betrieb in Production. Bei Bedarf bringst du Features auch bis zur UI und behältst so das gesamte Produkt im Blick.

Aufgaben

  • Backend und Architektur gestalten: Du entwickelst API-first Services, Datenmodelle und Systemgrenzen, die paddy zuverlässig, wartbar und skalierbar machen.
  • Features End-to-End shippen: Du begleitest Features vom Nutzerproblem über Backend und Datenmodell bis zur UI und bringst sie in Production.
  • AI Engineering umsetzen: Du baust Produktfunktionen mit LLM-APIs und agentischen Komponenten. Mit Tool Calling, Evals, Fehlerbehandlung und Monitoring sorgst du für zuverlässige Abläufe.
  • Production-Qualität sichern: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Systeme und nutzt Testing, CI/CD und Observability, um sie stabil zu betreiben.
  • Produktnah arbeiten: Du sprichst mit Lehrkräften, findest den Bedarf hinter ihren Wünschen und triffst mit Product und Design Entscheidungen, statt auf Tickets zu warten.

Qualifikation

  • Backend- und Architektur-Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb moderner Webanwendungen, idealerweise mit TypeScript, Node.js und Next.js. Du hast APIs, Datenmodelle und Backend-Services entworfen und umgesetzt.
  • Technisches Fundament: Du bist sicher in API-Design, Datenbanken und asynchronen Prozessen. Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes und Monitoring ist hilfreich.
  • Full-Stack-Kompetenz: Du kannst dich in React und Next.js bewegen und Features bei Bedarf selbst bis zur UI bringen.
  • Praktische AI-Engineering-Erfahrung: Du hast LLM-basierte Features oder agentische Systeme mit APIs umgesetzt. Du verstehst Tool Calling, typische Modellfehler und wie sich die Qualität solcher Funktionen prüfen und im Betrieb beobachten lässt.
  • Ownership und Urteilskraft: Du kommst mit offenen Anforderungen klar, findest einfache Lösungen für komplexe Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Systeme in Production.
  • Produktdenken: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Nutzer arbeiten, und kannst technische Entscheidungen mit ihrem tatsächlichen Bedarf verbinden.
  • Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Benefits

  • Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
  • Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
  • Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
  • Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess: 5 Tage

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

  1. Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
  2. Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
  3. Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
  4. Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
  5. Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

title: Automation & Industrial IT Engineer / Specialist (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at PFASuiki GmbH
description_html:
PFASuiki is setting the global standard for safe, sustainable PFAS destruction. Through advanced electrochemical oxidation (ECO), we transform contaminated streams into non-hazardous outputs and help solve one of today’s major environmental challenges.

We are looking for an Automation & Industrial IT Engineer / Specialist to develop the control, automation and data systems behind our pilot systems and future commercial products. You will take hands-on responsibility for PLC and SCADA development, equipment integration, operational data systems, testing and commissioning.

Tasks

• Develop, test and maintain PLC software for operating modes, sequences, control loops, alarms, interlocks and trips

• Build practical HMI and SCADA applications for plant control, monitoring, alarms, trends and fault diagnosis

• Integrate sensors, field devices and packaged equipment into the control system

• Perform I/O checks and troubleshoot issues across software, communications, PLC hardware and field devices

• Maintain systems for collecting, storing, backing up and accessing pilot and plant operational data

• Support company networks, devices, user access and backups in collaboration with external providers where required

• Prepare software tests and support FAT, dry and wet testing, startup and on-site commissioning

• Maintain structured documentation, including source code, backups, software releases, control descriptions, test results and network records

Requirements

• Degree, technician, Meister, vocational or equivalent qualification in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, industrial IT, computer science or a related field

• Practical experience programming and commissioning PLC-controlled industrial or process equipment

• Strong PLC programming skills, including structured programming, process sequences, control loops and online diagnostics

• Experience developing HMI or SCADA applications and working with industrial data

• Experience with industrial communications and equipment integration

• Practical understanding of networks, computers, backups, access control and cybersecurity

• Methodical, hands-on approach to troubleshooting across software, networks, PLCs and field devices

• Professional English; German is a plus for site work and supplier coordination

• Structured approach to software testing, version control, release management and documentation

Bonus:

• Functional safety or safety PLC experience

• Data analysis or automated engineering reporting experience

• Experience managing IT systems in a startup, laboratory or engineering environment

Benefits

• Real impact: Apply your engineering expertise to solving a major global environmental challenge

• Ownership: Take responsibility for the automation and industrial IT systems behind our technology

• Broad technical scope: Work across PLCs, SCADA, industrial communications, data systems and commissioning

• Startup culture: Join a dynamic, collaborative environment where your ideas can directly shape our technology and strategy

• Competitive package: Fixed salary plus performance-based variable compensation

• Additional benefits including public transportation and lunch subsidies

Ready to use automation and industrial IT to help make “forever chemicals” a problem of the past?

Join PFASuiki and help build the control and data infrastructure that takes our technology from pilot systems to commercial deployment.

If you combine strong automation skills with a hands-on engineering mindset and enjoy taking ownership, we want to hear from you.

title: Solution Engineer - AI Engineer - Global role - Hamburg based
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at EVIDENT Europe GmbH
description_html:
Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Evident employs around 2,000 people at a total of 57 locations worldwide. Evident Europe, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, employs approximately 350 people in 16 countries. The product portfolio includes a wide range of microscope systems used in clinical diagnostics, medical and basic research, as well as in various industrial areas.

Tasks

The primary objective of the AI Engineer is to create unique value propositions by ensuring our AI services are impactful and relevant. The AI Engineer will play a key role to upskill the capability of systematic AI adoption for the entire organization. This involves collaborating closely with stakeholders to understand our business goals and identify, assess and prioritize AI use cases. The AI Engineer is responsible for successful implementation and delivery of new AI services.

At Evident, you will turn business needs into practical AI solutions for teams across finance, HR, sales, service, legal and quality assurance. You will own solutions from initial request through development and delivery, working directly with stakeholders and external partners.

What you’ll do

  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases with business teams.
  • Design, build and scale AI services, including solutions using large language models and retrieval augmented generation (RAG).
  • Deliver working solutions at pace and integrate them into business processes.
  • Guide external development partners and explain technical choices to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Help teams adopt AI and share effective practices across the organization.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and deploying AI solutions independently.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft services, particularly Azure, and Anthropic’s Claude suite.
  • Knowledge of machine learning, LLMs, RAG and data engineering practices.
  • Clear communication, sound judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A relevant master’s degree or equivalent experience, plus 10+ years of experience in operational and strategic technology roles in an industrial setting.

The role can be based in Prague, with remote working, or Hamburg, with a 50/50 office arrangement.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours, incl. mobile work
  • 30 days of holiday time each year
  • 13 salaries a year
  • Regular training courses
  • Extensive company pension scheme
  • Payments towards an employee savings plan
  • Preventive healthcare
  • Joint company events and activities
  • Interesting, diversified field of activity in an international working environment

Evident Europe GmbH is an equal opportunities employer and we look forward to receiving your application.

description_html:
Vollzeit · Köln, hybrid · ab sofort
Hunderunde ist eine Gesundheitsmarke für Hunde aus Köln. Wir machen pflanzliche Futtertoppings, veganes Alleinfutter und Snacks für konkrete Probleme wie Verdauung, Fell, Gelenke oder Zähne. Tierärztlich mitentwickelt, ehrliche Rezepturen, keine Versprechen ohne Substanz.
Gegründet 2019 von Fabio und Luis, bekannt aus „Die Höhle der Löwen”, komplett gebootstrapped. 5% unseres Nettoumsatzes gehen an Tierschutzprojekte, unter anderem an ein Tierheim in Rumänien. Heißt: Jede Ad, die bei dir performt, hilft am Ende auch Hunden, um die sich sonst niemand kümmert.

Aufgaben

Du machst aus Kundensprache Ads, die verkaufen. Von der Idee bis zur Zahl im Account.
Du entwickelst die Konzepte, briefst Cutter, Designer*innen und On-Camera-Talent, schaltest die Kampagnen in Meta und Google und entscheidest anhand der Daten, was skaliert und was rausfliegt. Du arbeitest direkt mit Luis (Co-Founder, verantwortet Marketing und Marke).
Was du machst

  • Creative-Strategie für Meta und Google: Angles, Hooks, Formate. Deine Ideen kommen aus echten Kundenstimmen (Kommentare, Reviews, DMs, Support-Tickets), nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Mit KI schneller werden: Recherche, Kundenstimmen auswerten, Konzepte und Briefings mit Claude und Co. Du nutzt KI, um mehr und bessere Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
  • Produktion steuern: Concept One-Pager, Shoot Brief, Cut Brief. So klar, dass Cutter, Designer*innen und On-Camera-Talent ohne Rückfragen loslegen. Du produzierst nicht selbst, du sorgst dafür, dass das Richtige produziert wird.
  • Media Buying: Kampagnen im Meta Ads Manager und in Google Ads aufsetzen, steuern, testen und skalieren.
  • Auswerten und nachlegen: Performance mit unseren Attributions-Tools lesen und daraus die nächste Testrunde ableiten.
  • Creator-Content nutzen: Mit unserem Social- und Creator-Team zusammen aus Creator-Material starke Ads machen.
  • Sauber bleiben: Für Werbeaussagen bei Hundefutter gelten klare rechtliche Regeln. Du hast Lust, innerhalb dieser Regeln kreativ zu sein.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in Paid Social und Paid Search, idealerweise im DTC oder E-Commerce
  • Du beherrschst Meta Ads Manager und Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube/Demand Gen) hands-on
  • Du hast Creatives verantwortet, die nachweislich performt haben, und kannst erklären, warum
  • KI ist für dich Alltagswerkzeug: Claude, ChatGPT und Co. Du baust dir damit eigene Workflows für Recherche, Konzepte und Briefings
  • Gespür für Hooks, Schnitt und Text. Du musst nicht selbst schneiden oder designen, aber du erkennst, was den Scroll stoppt, und kannst es so briefen, dass es rauskommt
  • CAC, ROAS, CTR und Hook Rate sind für dich keine Fremdwörter
  • Eigentümer-Denken: Du wartest nicht auf Erlaubnis, sondern entscheidest und stehst dafür gerade
  • Ehrlichkeit, auch wenn’s unangenehm ist. Das ist bei uns nicht verhandelbar

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein Job mit Sinn: 5 % vom Nettoumsatz gehen in den Tierschutz. Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt.
  • Mitgestalten statt abarbeiten: Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Deine Ideen gehen live statt in Abstimmungsschleifen.
  • Hybrid: 3 Tage im Office in Köln, 2 Tage remote.
  • Workation: 2 x mal im Jahr fahren wir mit dem ganzen Team weg
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Weiterbildung: Für Kurse, Konferenzen und Tools
  • Schönes Office: In der Schanzenstraße in Köln
  • Offene Kultur: Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, Zahlen und Entscheidungen werden geteilt, Kritik ist Werkzeug, kein Angriff

Wir freuen uns über kreative Bewerbungen, vielleicht hast du ja auch schon direkt Idee, die wir besser machen können. Sei gern kreativ.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Die pbz ist ein seit 30 Jahren bestehendes Familienunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Essen, Außenstellen in Düsseldorf und Hamburg, sowie weiteren Partnerbüros im gesamten Bundesgebiet.

Ursprünglich als Architektur- und Ingenieurbüro gegründet, sind wir insbesondere im Bereich kritische Infrastruktur und konstruktivem Ingenieurbau tätig.

Dabei bieten wir unseren Kunden als Generalübernehmer, Management- und Ingenieurdienstleister in den Branchen Telekommunikation, Energie, Retail und Mobilität von individuellen Leistungspaketen bis zum Full-Service-Angebot maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für jede Art von Bauvorhaben und Projektmanagement.

Aufgaben

Baugruppen und Bauteile parametrisieren, standardisieren und Planungsprozesse effizienter gestalten. Du hilfst uns beim Aufbau unserer digitalen Bauteilkästen und Koordination unserer Projektteams.

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Bauteilbibliotheken, Vorlagen und Familien
  • Aufbau und Pflege automatisierter Modellprüfungen und Qualitätskontrollen

  • Überprüfung der BIM-Datenübergabe und datentechnischen Qualität
  • Aufbau eines Datenmanagements im Common Data Environment (CDE)
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung festgelegter Standards durch Schulungen, Workshops und regelmäßige Überprüfungen
  • Technische Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurswesen, Architektur oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrungen im Bereich kritische Infrastruktur und Mobilfunk von Vorteil
  • Erfahrungen im Aufbau und der Verwaltung von Standards und Bauteilbibliotheken
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Revit oder vergleichbarer Softwareanwendungen
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich der Modellprüfung sowie grafischer Algorithmus-Editoren von Vorteil, Kenntnisse in Python optional
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office Produkten
  • Genaue, selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, sowie konzeptionelles Denken und Handeln
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Familienunternehmen mit wertschätzendem und teamorientiertem Umfeld
  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
  • Homeoffice, vorzugsweise am Standort Essen (Hybrid)
  • Firmenevents mit zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen
  • Faire und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

  • Diverse Möglichkeiten zur Pausengestaltung (Kicker, Billiard- und Airhockey-Tisch, Dart, Spielekonsolen)

  • u.v.m.
