title: Project Manager |  Customer Engagement & Communication (H/F)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Moka.care
description_html:
🤝 Qui nous sommes

Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.
Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale :
Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.
Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.
Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care, bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.
Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.
La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.
 

🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.
  • Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.
  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.
 

👉 Tes futures missions 

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...
  • Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.
  • Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

Engagement utilisateurs

  • Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.
  • Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care.
  • Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...

Notoriété et thought leadership

  • Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.
  • Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.
  • Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.
 
L'entraide est très importante chez Moka.
De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si 

  • Tu as au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne.
  • Tu es à l'aise à l'oral, et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.
  • Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie, organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.
  • Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.
  • Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design (nous utilisons Figma). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo, c’est un vrai plus.
  • Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche.
  • Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais, te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

  • Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.
  • Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.
  • Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail. 
  • Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.
  • Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

  • Accès à Moka.Care : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités.
  • Work-life balance: 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois).
  • Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop.
  • Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois).
  • Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour.
  • Gymlib, pour faire du sport;
  • Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT.
  • Leeto, pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE.
  • Mutuelle : SideCare.
  • 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo.
  • Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise.

Rémunération :

Package annuel brut entre 43 200 euros et 47 200 euros annuel brut (fixe + cagnotte May), selon nos grilles de rémunération en interne.

Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne.

🎤 Processus de recrutement

Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail.

  • 30 minutes de screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations.
  • Une première étude de cas pour évaluer tes compétences, et approfondir ton expérience.
  • Une seconde étude de cas pour te mettre en situation face à des enjeux client concrets.
  • Un entretien Values fit pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront.
  • Offre et reverse interview: l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision.

Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe.

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities

description_html:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

Harvey's law school program has reached 50+ US schools in year one. Now we are taking it global, and we need the right person to lead that charge expanding in the EMEA, and APAC markets.

As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

You will start by taking over account management of existing EMEA partner schools and then look to sign and expand our presence across the region. You report directly to the Head of Legal Partnerships, Law Schools (New York).

What You'll Do

  • School Partnerships: Lead outreach, relationship development, and onboarding for EMEA law schools — from flagship institutions to smaller schools.

  • Market Expansion: Build the playbook for Harvey’s Academic presence in each new EMEA/International market together with Law School Lead; execute new international launches throughout the year.

  • Cross-functional: Partner with Harvey's GTM commercial team, legal engineering, and marketing on in-market events, firm-to-school pipeline, and co-activation opportunities.

  • Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for every school in your portfolio — owning relationships with faculty, library staff, student organizations, and administrators across each partner institution.

  • Training & Enablement: Run all product training, demos, workspace setup, and activation events for your portfolio — including semester-start all-hands pushes, large-group faculty workshops, and 1:1 curriculum advisory sessions. Draw on the global Content Specialist and CS Lead for materials and operational support.

  • Ambassador Programs: Launch and own the EMEA student ambassador and faculty champion networks, adapting the US/UK model for European legal education norms.

  • Curriculum Advisory: Advise faculty and curriculum committees on how to integrate Harvey into courses, clinics, and legal writing programs — doing the hands-on work that makes academic embeds real.

What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Law School Manager, EMEA role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • Law degree preferred — deep understanding of how EMEA law schools are structured and how faculty, students, and administrators operate

  • Strong experience in legal practice, legal tech, legal innovation, or academic programs — experience in a client-facing or externally-facing role is a strong differentiator

  • Proven ability to manage a portfolio of relationships in a high-growth or startup environment — you keep up with a high volume without losing account depth

  • Comfortable running product trainings and demos for audiences ranging from first-year students to senior faculty and deans

  • Entrepreneurial and self-directed — you build from scratch, operate without a playbook, and hold yourself accountable across multiple markets

  • Strong organizational instincts — you can manage many schools across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Based in London, Paris, or Madrid, 3 days a week in office; Willing and able to travel across Europe, US, and other international jurisdictions for work.

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Crowdsec
description_html:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

  • Experience with Hubspot

Soft Skills

  • You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships

  • You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs

  • You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone

Why join CrowdSec?

  • You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup

  • Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community

  • You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline

  • We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar.

description_html:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry?

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.


That’s enough about us – what about you?

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

Position Summary:

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.


Key position responsibilities:

  • Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation

  • Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)

  • Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio

  • Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy

  • Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients

  • Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information

  • Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product

  • Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service

  • Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

  • Perform other special projects or duties when required


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Experience required:

  • Problem solving mindset

  • Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Good analytical skills with attention to detail

  • Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

title: CDI - MODELISTE FLOU ET/OU TAILLEUR (H/F)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at JACQUEMUS
description_html:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE ROLE


En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Interpréter les croquis et les références du studio pour créer les patronages
  • Travailler les volumes en coupe à plat et en moulage
  • Réaliser et modifier les toiles
  • Suivre le montage des prototypes avec l'atelier
  • Animer les essayages et proposer des ajustements de coupe et de proportions
  • Faire évoluer les patronages jusqu'à la validation finale
  • Transmettre au bureau d'études des modèles et des dossiers techniques complets
 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Formation en modélisme (BTS, DMA, ESMOD, AICP, Chambre Syndicale ou équivalent)
  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que modéliste dans une maison de luxe ou de prêt-à-porter haut de gamme
  • Spécialisation flou et/ou tailleur, avec une bonne connaissance des matières associées (soie, crêpe, lainages, tissus structurés…)
  • Maîtrise de la coupe à plat et du moulage ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO est un plus
  • Sensibilité créative et bonne compréhension de l'univers de la Maison
  • Sens du volume, du détail et du bien-aller
  • Capacité à échanger avec le studio et à tenir les délais de collection
 
Ce poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Tissus, le/la Chargé(e) de Sourcing et Développement Textile Senior assure le sourcing et le développement des matières textiles pour les collections de prêt-à-porter Homme et Femme JACQUEMUS.

Grâce à son expertise textile, sa sensibilité produit et sa connaissance du marché, elle/il identifie les matières adaptées à la vision créative de la Maison et accompagne leur développement jusqu’à leur transmission aux équipes Achats.

  • Suivre le budget de développement textile.

  • Expertise des matières et bonne connaissance des fournisseurs et techniciens textiles.

title: Senior Account Executive - Hospitals
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tandem Health
description_html:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: Founding Customer Training Manager - France (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Voize
description_html:
🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

💡 Your Mission: Own the training experience for users in France

As our Founding Customer Training Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and scaling the training program for our expansion into France. You'll inherit a proven methodology from the German market and adapt it for French healthcare facilities. You will motivate and engage groups of 10-15 caregivers, empowering them to embrace the technology and improve their documentation workflow.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Lead in-person training sessions for new customer deployments, training groups of healthcare providers in French-speaking regions.

  • Refine training materials and playbooks for the French market and for individual customers as needed.

  • Travel to customer sites (estimated 2-3 weeks per month, depending on deployment schedule) to deliver on-site training and support go-live activities across France.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product, and our German training team to optimize training approach and share insights.

  • Measure and report on training effectiveness, using adoption metrics and feedback to continuously improve our approach.

  • Ensure compliance with French healthcare regulations and documentation requirements (GDPR, standards, etc.).

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years in training, onboarding, or customer enablement in B2B, ideally healthcare or another technical environment - and you have built a program from scratch, not just delivered one

  • Proven track record designing and delivering in-person training to non-technical and mixed-ability audiences

  • Business fluent level of French (C2 or bilingual) including regional and cultural nuance, plus working English for the international team

  • You use adoption metrics and feedback to sharpen your approach, and you can work around legacy EHRs and limited IT infrastructure

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • Become a co-creator of our success with virtual stock options.

  • France-based opportunity. Work from anywhere in France (travel to customer sites as needed). We have bases in Berlin and are expanding into France.

  • Flexible working hours because you know best when you work most efficiently.

  • Open culture with regular team collaboration and learning opportunities.

  • You'll work on the founding team for a high-growth function - significant opportunity for impact and rapid growth.

  • Your work will make a real impact, helping alleviate workload for healthcare professionals and improving care documentation quality.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year + French public holidays.

✨ Ready to talk?

We look forward to your application. If you're curious about how training intersects with adoption, customer success, and healthcare transformation, we'd love to meet you—no matter who you are or what background you have.

Questions? Reach out to Brian Gallagher (Head of Training & Onboarding) at Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

description_html:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

    • Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

    • Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

    • Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

    • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

    • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

    • MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

    • Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

      • Nice-to-haves

      • Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

      • Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

      • Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at The Flex
description_html:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

As part of this high-impact platform team, you will play a key role in fostering engineering excellence by creating, implementing and maintaining scalable core processes to enhance development efficiency, reliability, and quality within the Camunda 8 code bases, as well as the Engineering-wide organization processes.

As Camunda 8 evolves into the leader of the agentic orchestration market, your mission is to ensure our internal development lifecycle is just as autonomous and gets us there in a frictionless manner. You will work with infrastructure and core software engineering teams to ensure smooth workflows, robust dependency management, and continuous improvement of CI processes in the era of AI-first development; enabling the Camunda 8 engineering teams to focus better on the core product development.

What you'll be doing:

  • AI-Augmented Engineering: Lead the shift toward an automated engineering lifecycle by implementing and orchestrating unified processes in the Camunda 8 repos - including AI-assisted processes like release management, autonomous dependency updates, and proactive CVE remediation.

  • Continuously optimize CI/release health and development velocity using a metric-driven approach to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in our AI-first workflows

  • Collaborate with the key stakeholders to implement the CI strategy and engineering best practices, by creating a positive impact within the Engineering organization.

  • Identify friction points in engineering workflows and evolve them into automated, self-sustaining systems that can handle the increased volume of an AI-augmented workforce - by effectively partnering with software engineers, engineering leaders and cross-team stakeholders

What you bring:

Must Haves:

  • Strong Software Engineering experience with a track record of delivering results (preferably, in Java)

    • Specialization: Fullstack or Backend

  • Passion for engineering operational excellence beyond writing code, including CI/CD optimization, dependency management, release process enhancements, metrics collection, and build efficiency (DevOps mindset), and track record of owning and developing engineering processes end-to-end

  • Strong experience in CI build tools (GitHub Actions, Java ecosystem - Maven, Docker) and automations (Shell/Python) in complex projects (e.g. monorepositories)

  • Being a strong collaborator across teams and delivering impactful solutions in a platform-like environment.

  • Experience in developer experience tools and process optimization & driving AI adoption

You thrive in taking ownership of the codebase, as well as how you deploy and operate software. You are comfortable with the “you build it, you run it” mindset.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience designing efficient cross-team operations

  • Practical experience with Camunda or other BPMN systems

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #C1

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer fair, transparent, and competitive compensation. For new hires, we typically place candidates in the first half of the range, allowing room for growth over time.

Annual Total Cash (base salary + 100% variable, where applicable):

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Contrôleur de gestion & Data analyste
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hi
description_html:
NOTRE ONG :               

Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence avec ses plus de 3500 collaborateurs.

 

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens.

CONTEXTE :

Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN), dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion.

Votre future équipe est constituée de 8 collaborateurs (7 à Lyon, 1 au Luxembourg), avec un périmètre international stimulant (interactions avec les États-Unis et l'Allemagne).

OBJECTIFS DU POSTE :

Ce poste permet d'avoir deux dimensions complémentaires :

- la valorisation et la fiabilisation des données financières,

- et le pilotage financier d'un portefeuille comprenant prioritairement l'Association Nationale UK.

Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision.

L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. Le poste transforme les besoins métiers en indicateurs et tableaux de bord exploitables, accompagne les responsables budgétaires et contribue à l'amélioration continue des processus et systèmes d'information financiers.

Ce poste permet de transformer les données complexes en véritables outils d'aide à la décision !

Requirements

Votre parcours & vos expériences

Formation : Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce, d'une école d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un Master 2 en gestion/finance.

Expériences :

  • Une solide pratique confirmée en data analyse, contrôle de gestion, reporting financier ou sur une fonction hybride finance/data.
  • Une première expérience ou des interactions régulières avec un organe de direction type conseil d'administration serait un plus.

Vos compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise des outils : Niveau avancé sur Excel et sur un outil de data visualisation (Power BI idéalement).
  • Data & Process : Capacité à structurer les données, formaliser des règles de gestion, automatiser les reportings et comprendre les environnements ERP, Data Warehouse et la gouvernance des données.
  • Finance : Maîtrise solide du contrôle budgétaire, de l'analyse d'écarts, des clôtures et des réconciliations.
  • Un plus apprécié : Connaissance de Navision, Workday, SQL ou d'outils équivalents.

Vos savoir-être

  • Rigueur & Fiabilité : Grand sens de la qualité et de l'organisation, avec une excellente gestion des priorités.
  • Esprit d'analyse : Capacité à synthétiser, vulgariser et proposer des améliorations continues orientées solutions.
  • Relationnel : Pédagogie, écoute active des besoins métiers et goût pour la coopération avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Langues

  • Français : Courant.
  • Anglais : Courant obligatoire (écrit et oral), compte tenu du périmètre international (UK).

Et surtout l'envie de travailler au sein d'Handicap International !

ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL :

Pendant la durée de ce contrat, le siège d'Handicap International va déménager.

Les locaux actuels et futurs sont facilement accessibles en transports en commun (bus, métro).

Au sein du bâtiment, des rampes d'accès et ascenseurs garantissent une meilleure circulation.  Tous les postes de travail sont situés en Open Space mais des box sont disponibles à chaque étage pour travailler dans le calme si nécessaire. L’espace de travail est très lumineux.

Une référente handicap est présente pour répondre aux éventuelles questions et vous accompagner dans vos démarches. En fonction de vos besoins, le poste peut être aménagé.

Benefits

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous :

  • Contrat CDI
  • Rémunération : à partir de 30 000 brut/annuel.
  • Des valeurs fortes : Humanité, Inclusion, Engagement et intégrité ! Et une proximité avec le terrain via des conférences régulières.
  • Statut Cadre
  • Une organisation flexible dans l'organisation du travail avec une charte de télétravail
  • Carte tickets resto (prise en charge 60% par HI),
  • Transport :  un forfait mobilité durable existe. Prise en charge 50% des abonnements transports.
  • Bien-être et santé : mutuelle et prévoyance, sensibilisations internes diverses, un pôle Qualité de Vie et Conditions de Travail actif
  • CSE et avantages sociaux :  Œuvres sociales du CSE pour améliorer votre quotidien
  • Une vie associative culturelle, sportive et sociale dynamique

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature !

title: AI Consultant

description_html:
Rejoignez une équipe spécialisée dans les solutions Microsoft, l’intelligence artificielle générative et l’IA agentique, et accompagnez nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions IA à forte valeur ajoutée.

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis l’identification des cas d’usage jusqu’à la mise en production et l’industrialisation des agents IA.

Requirements

Cadrer et conseiller les clients

Accompagner les clients dans l’identification, la définition et la priorisation de leurs cas d’usage IA, en cohérence avec leurs enjeux métiers et leur stratégie Microsoft.

Animer des ateliers avec les équipes métiers et IT afin de comprendre les besoins, challenger les idées et identifier les solutions les plus pertinentes.

Traduire les besoins métiers en solutions fonctionnelles IA concrètes et réalisables.

Conseiller les directions métiers et les DSI sur les possibilités offertes par Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio et l’IA agentique.

Identifier les prérequis nécessaires au déploiement d’agents IA en production : données, gouvernance, sécurité, conformité, architecture et conduite du changement.

Participer à la définition des feuilles de route IA et des stratégies d’adoption.

Concevoir et développer des agents IA

Concevoir et développer des agents IA avec Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Configurer les topics, actions, outils, instructions et mécanismes d’orchestration des agents.

Utiliser Power Automate pour automatiser les processus métiers et orchestrer les actions des agents.

Connecter les agents aux données et services Microsoft 365, notamment SharePoint, Teams et Dataverse.

Intégrer les agents aux applications métiers et services externes via des connecteurs, APIs et autres mécanismes d'intégration.

Participer aux phases de POC, prototypage, tests et itérations jusqu’à l’obtention de solutions fiables et prêtes pour la production.

Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de fiabilité et de contrôle tels que le grounding, les tests, les garde-fous, l’évaluation et la supervision des conversations.

Analyser les performances des agents et contribuer à leur amélioration continue.

Participer à des démonstrations, ateliers pratiques, formations et hackathons afin de favoriser l’adoption des solutions IA.

Industrialiser et sécuriser les solutions

Contribuer à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques pour le déploiement et la gestion du cycle de vie des agents IA.

Participer à la définition et à l'amélioration des pratiques ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) sur Power Platform.

Contribuer à la structuration des environnements Power Platform et aux stratégies de déploiement.

Participer aux phases de tests, recette, mise en production et stabilisation des solutions.

Veiller à la qualité, la sécurité, la gouvernance et la maintenabilité des solutions développées.

Documenter les architectures, configurations, processus et solutions afin de faciliter leur exploitation et leurs évolutions futures.

Sensibiliser les clients aux enjeux de gouvernance, conformité, sécurité et Responsible AI.

Développer l’expertise IA

Assurer une veille technologique sur Copilot Studio, l’IA agentique, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform et Azure AI.

Explorer les nouvelles fonctionnalités et identifier leur potentiel pour les projets clients.

Partager les retours d’expérience et les bonnes pratiques avec les équipes.

Contribuer à la création de méthodes, frameworks, accélérateurs et offres autour de l’IA.

Participer aux activités de pré-vente, réponses aux appels d’offres et cadrage de projets IA.

Accompagner la montée en compétences des consultants et contribuer au partage de connaissances au sein de la communauté IA.

Compétences techniques attendues

Expertise Microsoft Copilot

Très bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Expérience pratique de la conception d’agents, notamment :

Topics

Actions

Tools

Orchestration

Gestion du contexte conversationnel

Publication et déploiement multi-canaux

Power Platform

Solide expérience sur :

Power Automate

Power Apps

Dataverse

Bonne compréhension des environnements Power Platform, des solutions et des principes d’ALM.

Une connaissance des pratiques de gouvernance et du Power Platform CoE constitue un avantage.

Microsoft 365

Bonne connaissance de l’écosystème Microsoft 365.

Expérience avec SharePoint et Microsoft Teams, notamment sur les aspects architecture, intégration et sécurité.

La connaissance de Microsoft Graph et des APIs Microsoft constitue un plus.

IA générative et agentique

Bonne compréhension des concepts liés à l’IA générative et aux agents IA.

Connaissance pratique ou théorique de :

RAG

Prompt engineering

Grounding

Tool/function calling

Évaluation des modèles et agents

Guardrails

Orchestration des agents

Sensibilité aux enjeux de fiabilité, de sécurité et de gouvernance des solutions IA.

Technologies complémentaires

La connaissance des technologies suivantes est appréciée :

Azure AI / Azure AI Foundry

Azure OpenAI Service

Azure Logic Apps

Microsoft Graph

APIs REST

Monit

title: Customer Care France - Accounting
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Qonto
description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


➡️ Mission

Join us as a Customer Care Manager to help French solo entrepreneurs get the most out of Qonto's brand-new accounting offer. You'll own their day-to-day questions in Zendesk , working under the guidance of Janita, Lead Customer Service, on a scope you'll help shape from day one.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own the ticket queue: Answer French solo entrepreneurs' questions by email and chat, and hop on the phone when a topic calls for it.
  • Bridge with our accountants: Take over client requests handed off by our accountants so they can focus on the accounting itself.
  • Build the playbook from scratch: Create FAQs, macros, and better ways of working, since this scope is brand new.
  • Feed insights back to Product: Flag recurring issues so the team fixes the root cause, not just the ticket.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • You learn fast: You've picked up complex, technical topics on your own before — no accounting background needed, just the appetite to learn it.
  • You're fluent in French: Native or near-native fluency, both written and spoken.
  • You're organized under pressure: You juggle email, chat, and calls without letting anything slip.
  • You're customer-obsessed: You naturally put yourself in the client's shoes before answering.
  • You're AI-curious: You don't need to be an AI power user yet, but you're open to using it in your day-to-day.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A ground-floor seat on a brand-new, high-visibility initiative.
  • Real ownership over process: you'll help build the FAQs, macros, and workflows for this scope, not just follow them.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Janita Käyhkö, Customer Care Lead at Qonto. She grew from CSM into a multi-team leader across Lyyti, Regate, and now Qonto (following Regate's acquisition). She's built processes from scratch and knows how to dig into complex client problems. She’s an empathetic manager who gives her team the context and autonomy to own their projects, and expects them to bring solutions.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

  • Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

    • Partner Relationship Management:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

  • Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

  • Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

    • Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

    • Program Development & Optimization:

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management


    • Qualifications:
  • Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent. 

  • You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment. 

  • You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology

  • Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, KPI driven approach.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
